summary: 两项长期 PR 合并：EIP-8141 对 frame 交易禁用 EIP-3607 检查，以及 shemnon 的加密敏捷交易（CATX）EIP，把交易体与签名分离以便迁移后量子签名。pochenai 收紧 EIP-8130 创建条目校验，misilva73 修复 bal-devnet-6 暴露的 EIP-8037 问题。moodysalem 提出会自动过期的 ERC-20 授权。

items.title: EIP-8141：对 frame 交易禁用 EIP-3607 检查
items.title_en: EIP-8141: disable the EIP-3607 check for frame transactions

items.title: 新增 EIP：加密敏捷交易
items.note: （shemnon）合并：CATX 用扁平结构把交易体与签名分开，签名按位置承诺以防密钥替换，尾部签名可剥离以支持 ZK 签名聚合，迁移后量子签名不必改交易语义。
items.note_en: (shemnon), merged: CATX uses a flat structure that separates the body from signatures, commits signatures by position to prevent key substitution and lets trailing signatures be stripped for ZK aggregation, so post-quantum migration does not change transaction semantics.

items.title: EIP-8130：创建条目增加已有账户与代码大小检查
items.note: （pochenai）提交：除 code_size(from) == 0 外，还要求 nonce(from) == 0 且无既有 owner_config，防止创建条目被重放到反事实地址上已有交易记录的 EOA。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: add create entry existing account and code size guards
items.note_en: (pochenai), submitted: besides code_size(from) == 0, it now requires nonce(from) == 0 and no existing owner_config, so a create entry cannot be replayed against an EOA with history at the counterfactual address.

items.title: EIP-8037：修复 bal-devnet-6 发现的问题
items.note: （misilva73）提交：如合约创建交易回滚时退还新账户部分的固有状态 gas；EIP-8037：澄清 SELFDESTRUCT 收费（misilva73）提交并合并。
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted: for example refunding the new account part of intrinsic state gas when a contract creation transaction reverts; EIP-8037: clarify SELFDESTRUCT charges (misilva73), submitted and merged.

items.title: EIP-8037：澄清 SELFDESTRUCT 收费
items.note: EIP-8037：修复 bal-devnet-6 发现的问题（misilva73）提交：如合约创建交易回滚时退还新账户部分的固有状态 gas；EIP-8037：澄清 SELFDESTRUCT 收费（misilva73）提交并合并。
items.note_en: EIP-8037: fix bugs from bal-devnet-6 (misilva73), submitted: for example refunding the new account part of intrinsic state gas when a contract creation transaction reverts; EIP-8037: clarify SELFDESTRUCT charges (misilva73), submitted and merged.

summary_en: Two long running PRs merged: EIP-8141 disabling the EIP-3607 check for frame transactions, and shemnon's Cryptographically Agile Transactions (CATX) EIP, which separates the transaction body from signatures to ease post-quantum migration. pochenai tightened EIP-8130 create entry validation, and misilva73 fixed EIP-8037 issues surfaced by bal-devnet-6. moodysalem proposed ERC-20 approvals that expire automatically.
